response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished full-stack/web software developer with strong experience in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, but the role requires deep hardware expertise in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator performance architecture, and hardware-software co-design. The resume shows no experience with computer architecture, GPU/SIMD architectures, deep-learning workload optimization, or silicon performance modeling, making this a fundamental domain mismatch despite the candidate's seniority in software engineering.
strengths: Extensive software engineering experience (18+ years) with strong craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD)
Some low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (async I/O, fibers, caching at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
Meets years-of-experience threshold with a BS in Computer Science
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, or hardware-software co-design experience
No background in AI accelerators, GPU architecture, SIMD/MIMD, or deep-learning workload optimization
Career trajectory centered on web/product development, not performance architecture or systems research

key_factors.factor: No AI/DL workload or accelerator experience
